name: 卡瓦顿
title: 二次元怪兽
text:
《布莱泽奥特曼》中的二次元怪兽卡瓦顿。受到特殊宇宙线与阳光影响，涂鸦会实体化成为怪兽，日落后恢复成原来的画。布莱泽世界中的卡瓦顿由纯在朋友秘密基地帐篷里的涂鸦实体化，通常只顾睡觉；防卫队因它妨碍公共设施和市民生活而攻击，导弹却被柔软身体弹开，反而波及周围。

身高：40厘米—30米。体重：400克—20000吨。
version_scope: 仅2023布莱泽版卡瓦顿，不覆盖1966A/B。
forms_review: 新布莱泽JP灰绿底自然全体与三个局部细节实看，鼻端/自然背峰/近肢/完整锥尾可见，作为本人身份和外轮廓源。远肢侧向自遮正常；不套英雄鳍冠尺或176共同站高。
source_correction: 旧主图是彩色布莱泽城市照，旧黑白判断错误；不改旧元数据字节。

A.origin: 少年涂鸦受宇宙线和阳光照射实体化

B.origin: 孩子们在A的涂鸦上添画后形成凶猛外形，性格仍爱睡觉

fact_sources.exact_text: TOP ULTRA KAIJU Gavadon ULTRA KAIJU GAVADON Share A kaiju materialized from doodles under the influence of special cosmic rays that rained down to Earth. When certain unknown elements in the cosmic rays fuse with the sun's rays, the two-dimensional object will transform into a three-dimensional object. When the sun sets, it returns to its original state; therefore, Gavadon disappears and reverts to its original doodle. Gavadon was a doodle that Gento's son, Jun, drew in his sketchbook in a reserved manner inside the tent of his friend Arata’s secret base under the bridge.That night, a mysterious light from the sky caused the materialization. Gavadon was materialized into several dozen meters in size, coherently to its doodle. Even when Gavadon materializes to such size, what it only does is just sleep. However, the the top brass of the GGF decides that even if Gavadon is merely sleeping, it is a threat to civilian life by interfering with lifelines. Taking into account the possibility that Gavadon may wake up and start rampaging, the GGF decide to attack Gavadon with guided missiles after the residents have been evacuated.
